name: AC Hotel Penang
short_description: A 423-room European-style select-service hotel in Bukit Jambul, converted from the former Vistana Penang. Handy for the airport, Bayan Lepas industrial zone and Queensbay Mall, about 20-25 minutes from George Town.
ai_summary: AC Hotel Penang is an AC Hotels by Marriott property in Bukit Jambul, Bayan Lepas, occupying the former Vistana Penang tower (423 rooms over 28 floors) that YTL Hotels refurbished and rebranded as one of the first AC Hotels in Asia-Pacific. True to the AC concept, it is European-influenced select-service: clean, minimalist design, an AC Kitchen restaurant for the Asian-Western breakfast buffet, and an AC Lounge for signature cocktails and light dining, plus an outdoor pool with a kids' section and a 24-hour gym. Guest sentiment across TripAdvisor (roughly 500 reviews), Booking.com (near 2,000 reviews) and Trip.com skews positive-but-mixed. Reviewers consistently praise the spacious, freshly renovated rooms and family suites, friendly front-desk staff, easy airport access and good value; complaints cluster around an inconsistent, sometimes basic breakfast, occasional slow room-readiness or service lapses, small shower stalls in some rooms, and a location well removed from George Town's heritage core. The complimentary shuttle to Queensbay Mall and the Bayan Lepas industrial zone makes it practical for both business travellers and families seeking a suburban staycation base rather than a beach or old-town setting.

faqs.question: Was AC Hotel Penang previously another hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes. The property was formerly Vistana Penang Bukit Jambul and was refurbished and rebranded as AC Hotels by Marriott by YTL Hotels, making it one of the first AC Hotels in the Asia-Pacific region.

faqs.question: How far is AC Hotel Penang from the airport and George Town?
faqs.answer: It is roughly a 10-minute drive (about 6 km) from Penang International Airport and around 5 minutes from the First Penang Bridge exit. George Town's heritage core is farther away, about a 20-25 minute drive depending on traffic.

faqs.question: What dining and facilities does the hotel offer?
faqs.answer: AC Kitchen serves an international breakfast buffet and all-day dining, while the AC Lounge offers signature cocktails and light bites. Facilities include an outdoor pool with a children's section, a 24-hour fitness centre, meeting space, and a complimentary shuttle to Queensbay Mall and the Bayan Lepas industrial zone.

reviews.title: New Hotel in Penang - AC Hotel by Marriott Penang
reviews.author: Ee Pin
reviews.summary: Blog review of the rebranded former Vistana praises minimalist rooms, a comfy sofa-bed, studio units for longer stays, a gym and pool, and a varied breakfast. Location suits the Bayan Lepas industrial zone but is far from George Town.
